cadence: General notice generally 90 days; election notice generally 14 days after administrator notice
evidence_description: Notices, mailing proof, beneficiary/premium records
fails_if: Part-timers not counted fractionally; spouse/event missed; mailing proof absent.
trigger_condition: Group health plan and normally 20+ employees on >50% of typical business days in prior year.
trigger_plain: Group health plan and normally 20+ employees on >50% of typical business days in prior year.

cadence: Event notices; poster; records 3 years
evidence_description: Eligibility/rights/designation notices, certification, ledger, benefits/restoration
fails_if: Remote worksite wrong; state/federal leave uncoordinated; late notice; intermittent leave/bonus/restoration wrong.
trigger_condition: Employer 50+ in 20 weeks; employee usually 12 months, 1,250 hours, and 50 within 75 miles.
trigger_plain: Employer 50+ in 20 weeks; employee usually 12 months, 1,250 hours, and 50 within 75 miles.

cadence: Within 120 days after DEQ notice; summaries at 12 and 24 months
evidence_description: On-site plan/EMS, completion notice, implementation summaries
fails_if: Generic; practicable options/key toxics omitted; summaries late/unsupported.
requirement_name: Toxics Use and Hazardous Waste Reduction plan/EMS
trigger_condition: Facility is TRI Form A/R reporter, LQG, or SQG.
trigger_plain: Facility is TRI Form A/R reporter, LQG, or SQG.

cadence: Before interstate sale; update after formula/package/hazard/use change
evidence_description: FHSA assessment and consumer label/packaging review
fails_if: Industrial label/SDS substituted; chronic hazard/child exposure missed; statements obscured or undersized.
trigger_condition: Hazardous product is intended/packaged for household or consumer use under CPSC jurisdiction.
trigger_plain: Hazardous product is intended/packaged for household or consumer use under CPSC jurisdiction.

cadence: Monthly/quarterly as rule allows; retain records 3 years
evidence_description: Membership/charter, minutes, attendance, inspections, action tracking
fails_if: Wrong option; poor worker representation; vague minutes; actions never close; shifts/sites omitted.
trigger_condition: Every employer except sole owner who is only employee must choose compliant option.
trigger_plain: Every employer except sole owner who is only employee must choose compliant option.

cadence: Record on receipt; employee allegations 30 years, others 5 years
evidence_description: Section 8(c) log and underlying records
fails_if: Complaint trapped in HR/quality; wrong retention; product cannot link to chemical; allegations filtered out.
trigger_condition: Manufacturer/processor/distributor receives allegation of significant adverse health/environment reaction.
trigger_plain: Manufacturer/processor/distributor receives allegation of significant adverse health/environment reaction.

cadence: Each duty day; retain generally 6 months
evidence_description: ELD/RODS, short-haul time, supporting documents, edits
fails_if: Short-haul exceeded; yard/personal misuse; documents conflict; adverse exception preplanned.
trigger_condition: Covered interstate CMV driver without exception.
trigger_plain: Covered interstate CMV driver without exception.

cadence: Every payroll; changes July 1 annually
evidence_description: Work-location map, time/pay records, current poster
fails_if: Company address used instead of work location; travel unallocated; deductions reduce pay; annual update missed.
trigger_condition: Covered work in Portland metro, standard, or nonurban area.
trigger_plain: Covered work in Portland metro, standard, or nonurban area.

cadence: Medical before fit/use; annual fit test and training; evaluation as needed
evidence_description: Program, medical clearance, fit test, change schedule, training, inspections
fails_if: Clearance after use; facial hair; odor-based change; wrong cartridge; voluntary duties ignored.
trigger_condition: Respirator is required or voluntary use exceeds filtering-facepiece-only exception.
trigger_plain: Respirator is required or voluntary use exceeds filtering-facepiece-only exception.

cadence: Evaluate initially/after change; permit each entry; training before assignment/change; annual canceled-permit review
evidence_description: Inventory, program, permits, gas tests, rescue evaluation, training
fails_if: Bodily entry denied; rescue assumed; calibration/bump evidence absent; permits incomplete; contractors unmanaged.
trigger_condition: Employees enter a confined space with atmosphere, engulfment, trapping, or serious hazard.
trigger_plain: Employees enter a confined space with atmosphere, engulfment, trapping, or serious hazard.

cadence: Within 20 days; approved twice-monthly electronic schedule
evidence_description: Submission and rejection correction
fails_if: Rehire omitted; payroll date used; rejected file not fixed; classification inconsistent.
trigger_condition: New hire or rehire in Oregon.
trigger_plain: New hire or rehire in Oregon.

cadence: Per qualifying event
evidence_description: Proof of timely mailed continuation notices
fails_if: Missed Oregon 10-day election window (shorter than federal); no proof of mailing
trigger_condition: Fewer than 20 employees + group health plan
trigger_plain: Fewer than 20 employees + group health plan

cadence: Quarterly payroll reporting/contributions; notice continuous; per-event leave
evidence_description: Frances filings, contributions, poster, leave/restoration/equivalent-plan records
fails_if: Headcount wrong; payroll mismatch; discipline during leave; PTO/equivalent plan uncoordinated.
trigger_condition: Most employees covered; employers with 25+ employees pay employer share; smaller generally remit employee share.
trigger_plain: Most employees covered; employers with 25+ employees pay employer share; smaller generally remit employee share.

cadence: Initial/periodic; annual training; specified medical
citation: 29 CFR § 1910.1052 as adopted by Oregon OSHA
evidence_description: Monitoring, program, regulated area, medical, training
fails_if: TSCA/OSHA conflated; short/skin exposure omitted; supplied-air/objective-data errors
trigger_condition: Occupational exposure
trigger_plain: Occupational exposure

cadence: Review annually
evidence_description: Current handbook; superseded versions retired
fails_if: Old version circulating; missing Oregon-required policies (WFA harassment policy, sick time, PLO)

cadence: Update as revised SDSs arrive from suppliers
evidence_description: The SDS itself, all 16 sections present, readily accessible to employees
fails_if: Missing sections (esp. Section 8 PPE); pre-2015 MSDS format; access limited to an office
requirement_name: SDS on file, current, 16-section GHS format (user/employer side)

cadence: Compliance with new STAA/third-party-audit provisions by May 10, 2027
evidence_description: Updated RMP elements: STAA analysis, third-party audit arrangements, natural-hazard evaluation
fails_if: Plan untouched since before the 2024 amendments; no natural-hazard/climate evaluation
trigger_condition: RMP-covered facilities
trigger_plain: RMP-covered facilities

cadence: Review annually; train initially and before new exposure
evidence_description: CHP, Chemical Hygiene Officer, SOPs, controls, training, monitoring/medical records
fails_if: Production/QC misclassified; particularly hazardous substances lack controls; generic plan; hood unverified.
trigger_condition: Laboratory-scale hazardous chemical use under qualified supervision meets scope.
trigger_plain: Laboratory-scale hazardous chemical use under qualified supervision meets scope.

cadence: 300/301 within 7 days; post 300A Feb. 1-Apr. 30; retain/update 5 years
evidence_description: Forms 300/301/300A, privacy list, executive certification
fails_if: Workers' comp-only file; restricted/medical treatment misclassified; temps omitted; summary uncertified.
trigger_condition: >10 employees in prior year and not partially exempt; chemical sectors generally not exempt.
trigger_plain: >10 employees in prior year and not partially exempt; chemical sectors generally not exempt.

cadence: Within 3 months after threshold; update within 3 months of significant new information
evidence_description: SDS/list to SERC, LEPC, fire department
fails_if: Tier II assumed to cure initial duty; mixtures/maximum inventory wrong; new hazard not resubmitted.
trigger_condition: OSHA hazardous chemical ≥10,000 lb or EHS at lower of 500 lb or TPQ, subject to exemptions.
trigger_plain: OSHA hazardous chemical ≥10,000 lb or EHS at lower of 500 lb or TPQ, subject to exemptions.

cadence: Per leave/return event; notice continuously
evidence_description: Leave/reemployment, benefit/pension restoration, notice
fails_if: Lesser benefits; delayed reemployment/seniority; improper documentation; retaliation.
trigger_condition: Applicant/employee has past, current, or future uniformed service.
trigger_plain: Applicant/employee has past, current, or future uniformed service.

cadence: Each July 1-June 30 registration year; before covered activity
evidence_description: Current PHMSA registration certificate and receipt
fails_if: Wrong year/entity; shipping began first; assumed exception does not apply.
trigger_condition: Offers/transports quantities in §107.601, including placardable shipments and specified bulk, explosive, PIH, or radioactive quantities.
trigger_plain: Offers/transports quantities in §107.601, including placardable shipments and specified bulk, explosive, PIH, or radioactive quantities.

cadence: Generally within 45 days of request
evidence_description: Request log, complete production, fee/delivery proof
fails_if: Only personnel file; time/pay/discipline withheld; deadline missed; altered/excess fee.
trigger_condition: Current/former employee requests covered records.
trigger_plain: Current/former employee requests covered records.

cadence: Initial; every 6/12 months by result; annual training/medical
citation: 29 CFR § 1910.1028 as adopted by Oregon OSHA
evidence_description: Monitoring, regulated areas, plan, annual training, exams
fails_if: Trace/feedstock dismissed; STEL task omitted; controls replaced by respirator; eligibility wrong
trigger_condition: May reach 0.5 ppm action level or 1 ppm PEL, or emergency/dermal criteria
trigger_plain: May reach 0.5 ppm action level or 1 ppm PEL, or emergency/dermal criteria

cadence: Initial and after reportable changes
evidence_description: Certified Your DEQ Online site-identification filing
fails_if: Saved but not certified; ownership, location, contacts, NAICS, waste codes, or category inaccurate.
trigger_condition: Oregon site performs a regulated generator, transporter, recycler, treatment, storage, disposal, or episodic activity.
trigger_plain: Oregon site performs a regulated generator, transporter, recycler, treatment, storage, disposal, or episodic activity.

cadence: Planned ≥30 days before; unplanned within 72 hours plus form; event ≤60 days
evidence_description: Notification, inventory, labels, shipment, petition if second event
fails_if: Routine production called episodic; late notice; >60 days; waste remains; quantities mixed.
trigger_condition: VSQG/SQG temporarily exceeds category and elects Subpart L.
trigger_plain: VSQG/SQG temporarily exceeds category and elects Subpart L.

cadence: Each operation
evidence_description: Checklist, attendance/securement, hose/connection and departure verification
fails_if: Operator leaves; brakes/engine/grounding fail; hose compatibility/pressure unknown; caps/valves unchecked.
trigger_condition: Loads/unloads hazmat from motor vehicle/cargo tank.
trigger_plain: Loads/unloads hazmat from motor vehicle/cargo tank.

cadence: As practical, no later than 12 hours
evidence_description: NRC call record and incident log
fails_if: Waits for written report; parties assume other called; evacuation/closure criterion missed.
trigger_condition: Incident meets serious immediate-notice criteria.
trigger_plain: Incident meets serious immediate-notice criteria.

cadence: Every package/shipment
evidence_description: Specification, closure instructions/torque, compatibility/fill check
fails_if: Unauthorized inner package; closure differs from test; rating inadequate; reused package not inspected.
trigger_condition: Hazmat is offered.
trigger_plain: Hazmat is offered.

cadence: Monitor if may reach 85 dBA TWA; baseline within 6 months (or 1 year mobile); annual audiogram/training
evidence_description: Survey/dosimetry, audiograms, STS review, training, protector attenuation
fails_if: Overtime/maintenance omitted; audiogram late; STS unmanaged; NRR unadjusted; temps omitted.
trigger_condition: Exposure ≥85 dBA 8-hour TWA.
trigger_plain: Exposure ≥85 dBA 8-hour TWA.

cadence: Before production; annual report by March 1
evidence_description: EPA establishment number and annual production report
fails_if: Number belongs elsewhere; repackaging missed; zero production not reported; quantities unreconciled.
trigger_condition: Produces, formulates, repackages, relabels, or otherwise produces a pesticide/device/active ingredient.
trigger_plain: Produces, formulates, repackages, relabels, or otherwise produces a pesticide/device/active ingredient.

cadence: Before qualification; annual MVR review; retention per item
evidence_description: Application, MVR/history, road test, medical, annual review, violations
fails_if: MVR ordered not reviewed; prior employer incomplete; medical lapse; endorsements/test mismatch.
trigger_condition: Employs drivers subject to Part 391.
trigger_plain: Employs drivers subject to Part 391.

cadence: Each day/week
evidence_description: Daily/weekly time and classification/calculation
fails_if: Only federal weekly OT; blending/warehouse roles inconsistent; midnight shift manipulation; regular rate incomplete.
trigger_condition: Nonexempt employee works in manufacturing establishment; generally overtime after 10 hours/day and 40/week.
trigger_plain: Nonexempt employee works in manufacturing establishment; generally overtime after 10 hours/day and 40/week.

cadence: Surveillance audit annually; recertification every 3 years
evidence_description: Certificate + surveillance/recert audit reports
fails_if: Missed surveillance = suspension risk; website advertises cert nobody can produce
trigger_condition: Holds or advertises ISO 9001
trigger_plain: Holds or advertises ISO 9001

cadence: Before operation; MCS-150 every 24 months and after specified changes
evidence_description: Active USDOT/URS record and MCS-150 filing
fails_if: Inactive number; missed biennial month; stale address, fleet, cargo, hazmat, or operation status.
trigger_condition: Operates a covered commercial motor vehicle in interstate commerce or another federally covered operation.
trigger_plain: Operates a covered commercial motor vehicle in interstate commerce or another federally covered operation.

cadence: Before covered storage/use/construction; renew per fire marshal
citation: 2022 Oregon Fire Code §§ 105, 5001.5.2 and applicable Chapters 50-67
evidence_description: Fire permit, HMIS/HMMP, approved plans, inspection sign-off
fails_if: Temporary/waste/in-process/outdoor material omitted; hazard class/state wrong; control-area MAQ exceeded.
trigger_condition: Hazardous-material permit or MAQ thresholds are exceeded.
trigger_plain: Hazardous-material permit or MAQ thresholds are exceeded.

cadence: Continuous; generally 90 days
evidence_description: Dates/labels, inspections, contingency, training, referenced-unit and shipment records
fails_if: LQG month handled as SQG; tank/container/air rules missed; training/closure duty omitted.
trigger_condition: Generates ≥1,000 kg nonacute/month, >1 kg acute, or acute-residue threshold.
trigger_plain: Generates ≥1,000 kg nonacute/month, >1 kg acute, or acute-residue threshold.

cadence: Surveillance annually; recert every 3 years
evidence_description: Certificate + audit reports
fails_if: Same failure modes as ISO 9001
trigger_condition: Holds or advertises ISO 14001
trigger_plain: Holds or advertises ISO 14001

cadence: Timely process per known limitation
evidence_description: Request, interactive process, temporary-function and decision record
fails_if: Improper documentation demand; forced leave; temporary essential-function suspension not analyzed.
trigger_condition: 15+ employees and known pregnancy/childbirth-related limitation.
trigger_plain: 15+ employees and known pregnancy/childbirth-related limitation.

cadence: Verification cycle every 3 years
evidence_description: Verification report
fails_if: Lapsed while advertising membership
trigger_condition: NACD member
trigger_plain: NACD member

cadence: Annually by July 1
evidence_description: Form R/A, FTE/threshold, release/waste estimates
fails_if: FTE wrong; byproducts/impurities/otherwise-use omitted; waste unreconciled; PFAS de minimis misused.
trigger_condition: Covered NAICS, ≥10 FTEs, and activity threshold met; generally 25,000 lb manufactured/processed or 10,000 lb otherwise used, with lower PBT/PFAS thresholds.
trigger_plain: Covered NAICS, ≥10 FTEs, and activity threshold met; generally 25,000 lb manufactured/processed or 10,000 lb otherwise used, with lower PBT/PFAS thresholds.

cadence: Continuous; Oregon poster set updates July 1
citation: Applicable federal/Oregon laws, including ORS 653.050 and ORS chapter 657B
evidence_description: Current physical/electronic postings
fails_if: Old wage poster; HQ only; missing Paid Leave/sick/OSHA/workers comp/federal; inaccessible language.
trigger_condition: Has Oregon worksite/remote workers requiring access.
trigger_plain: Has Oregon worksite/remote workers requiring access.

cadence: Application/renewal on authority schedule; generally 5-year permit term
evidence_description: Permit, application, inventory, monitoring reports, annual certification
fails_if: Potential-to-emit/fugitives understated; units omitted; deviations/modifications not reported.
requirement_name: Clean Air Act Title V permit
trigger_condition: Major source, acid-rain source, covered incinerator, or other source required by CAA rules.
trigger_plain: Major source, acid-rain source, covered incinerator, or other source required by CAA rules.

cadence: ALE status annually; offer monthly; 1094-C/1095-C annually
evidence_description: ALE calculation, offer/affordability data, forms/receipts
fails_if: Related entities not aggregated; variable-hour method inconsistent; codes/affordability unsupported.
trigger_condition: Averaged 50+ full-time employees including FTEs, with controlled-group aggregation.
trigger_plain: Averaged 50+ full-time employees including FTEs, with controlled-group aggregation.

cadence: Within 60 days after EHS reaches TPQ; coordinator change within 30 days
evidence_description: SERC/LEPC notice, coordinator designation, planning information
fails_if: Mixtures/locations omitted; TPQ units/solid forms wrong; coordinator unreported; LEPC request ignored.
trigger_condition: Extremely hazardous substance is present at or above TPQ.
trigger_plain: Extremely hazardous substance is present at or above TPQ.

cadence: At point of generation; redo after material/process/cleaning/disposal change
evidence_description: Waste profile, process knowledge, analytical data, sampling rationale, waste codes
fails_if: SDS-only decision; listed/mixture rules missed; nonrepresentative sample; formula change ignored.
trigger_condition: Any discard, spent/off-spec material, residue, sludge, spill debris, lab waste, or container residue may be solid waste.
trigger_plain: Any discard, spent/off-spec material, residue, sludge, spill debris, lab waste, or container residue may be solid waste.

cadence: Initial; 6 months at action level, annual STEL; annual training; specified medical
citation: 29 CFR § 1910.1048 as adopted by Oregon OSHA
evidence_description: Monitoring, signs, training, medical, respirator/emergency records
fails_if: Resin/biocide/decomposition source omitted; odor used; peaks missed; sensitization ignored
trigger_condition: Exposure to gas/solution/releasing material
trigger_plain: Exposure to gas/solution/releasing material

cadence: Initial; 6 months at action level, 3 months above PEL; annual training/medical
citation: 29 CFR § 1910.1026 as adopted by Oregon OSHA
evidence_description: Monitoring, areas, hygiene, training, medical
fails_if: Total chromium substituted; welding/maintenance missed; day count/hygiene wrong
trigger_condition: Cr(VI) exposure from chromates, pigments, plating, welding, contamination
trigger_plain: Cr(VI) exposure from chromates, pigments, plating, welding, contamination

cadence: Before unsupervised work; within 6 months; annual review; specified retention
evidence_description: Job-specific plan, records, job descriptions, trainer qualification
fails_if: Generic HazCom only; tasks not mapped; annual late; temps omitted; evidence incomplete.
trigger_condition: LQG employees perform waste/emergency duties.
trigger_plain: LQG employees perform waste/emergency duties.

cadence: Before shipment; update after significant new hazard information
evidence_description: Classification file, 16-section SDS, shipped label, revision record
fails_if: Downstream uses ignored; mixture method unsupported; Section 2/label conflict; emergency phone fails; small-package relief misused.
trigger_condition: Manufactures/imports/distributes hazardous chemicals subject to HCS.
trigger_plain: Manufactures/imports/distributes hazardous chemicals subject to HCS.

cadence: Before placarded driving; TSA generally every 5 years subject to state cycle
evidence_description: CDL H/X and current TSA eligibility
fails_if: Endorsement lapse; placarded drive during renewal; tank endorsement missing; status not verified.
trigger_condition: Driver operates CMV requiring placards.
trigger_plain: Driver operates CMV requiring placards.

cadence: Initial; periodic by result; medical if action level ≥30 days/year; annual/biological clocks
citation: 29 CFR § 1910.1025 as adopted by Oregon OSHA
evidence_description: Air samples, blood lead/ZPP, medical opinions, training, compliance plan
fails_if: Maintenance/pigment/solder/battery work omitted; bad objective data; day/follow-up clocks wrong
trigger_condition: Inorganic lead may reach 30 µg/m³ TWA
trigger_plain: Inorganic lead may reach 30 µg/m³ TWA

cadence: Offeror 2 years; carrier 1; hazardous-waste manifest 3
evidence_description: Accessible full copy with acceptance date
fails_if: ERP omits certification/description; clock from invoice; inaccessible; manifest kept only 2 years.
trigger_condition: Offers/transports hazmat.
trigger_plain: Offers/transports hazmat.

cadence: Continuous; verify monthly and per shipment
evidence_description: Monthly calculation and authorized-destination receipts
fails_if: One month/acute threshold exceeded; >1,000 kg stored; ineligible destination.
trigger_condition: No more than 100 kg nonacute/month, 1 kg acute/month, and applicable accumulation limits.
trigger_plain: No more than 100 kg nonacute/month, 1 kg acute/month, and applicable accumulation limits.

cadence: Before covered activity; renew per license term
evidence_description: License/permit, responsible-person, acquisition/disposition and magazine records
fails_if: Reactive mixture not screened; responsible people omitted; magazine type/distance/inventory wrong.
trigger_condition: Manufactures, imports, deals in, acquires, or uses regulated explosive material.
trigger_plain: Manufactures, imports, deals in, acquires, or uses regulated explosive material.

cadence: When called in; during covered new-source permitting; per permit
evidence_description: Approved inventory, risk assessment, reduction plan, engagement record, permit conditions
fails_if: Toxics/byproducts/fugitives omitted; factors/scenarios/stack data unsupported.
trigger_condition: DEQ calls in an existing source or a new/modified source requires toxic-air risk assessment.
trigger_plain: DEQ calls in an existing source or a new/modified source requires toxic-air risk assessment.

cadence: Annual procedure inspection; initial/retraining after role, equipment, procedure, or knowledge change
evidence_description: Machine procedures, annual certification, training, group/shift/contractor records
fails_if: Generic procedure; pneumatic/hydraulic/gravity/thermal/chemical/electrical energy omitted; self-inspection; bad shift handoff.
trigger_condition: Servicing exposes worker to unexpected startup/energization/stored energy.
trigger_plain: Servicing exposes worker to unexpected startup/energization/stored energy.

cadence: Advance notice; signed copy within 30 days after termination; evaluate at execution/termination
evidence_description: Advance notice, signed agreement, threshold/interest analysis, post-termination copy
fails_if: First-day presentation; below threshold/nonexempt; >12 months; overbroad nonsolicit acts as noncompete.
trigger_condition: Uses noncompetition agreement and statutory salary/exempt/status/interest/duration criteria may be met.
trigger_plain: Uses noncompetition agreement and statutory salary/exempt/status/interest/duration criteria may be met.

cadence: Every manifested off-site shipment
evidence_description: Manifest/e-Manifest, authorization check, returned copy, discrepancy follow-up
fails_if: Codes/quantities mismatch; unauthorized destination; rejected load unresolved; no return tracking.
trigger_condition: Generator ships hazardous waste off site without exception.
trigger_plain: Generator ships hazardous waste off site without exception.

cadence: Initial/new function within 90 days under supervision; recurrent every 3 years
evidence_description: Awareness, function, safety, security, modal training/test/certification
fails_if: Generic-only; modality/function missing; calendar date wrong; supervisors/temps omitted; no test/certifier.
trigger_condition: Job directly affects hazmat transportation safety.
trigger_plain: Job directly affects hazmat transportation safety.

cadence: Before service and at least daily; each shift if continuous use
evidence_description: Dated pre-shift inspection and defect repair/removal
fails_if: Signed without operational checks; forks/chains/brakes/horn/leaks/tires/fuel/battery omitted; defect truck available.
trigger_condition: Facility operates powered industrial trucks.
trigger_plain: Facility operates powered industrial trucks.

cadence: Continuous; generally ≤1 year accumulation
evidence_description: Labels/start dates, shipment, training/information, handler notification
fails_if: Undated/leaking; broken items mismanaged; >5,000 kg without notification; bad destination.
trigger_condition: Manages batteries, lamps, mercury equipment, pesticides, aerosol cans, or state-added universal waste under Part 273.
trigger_plain: Manages batteries, lamps, mercury equipment, pesticides, aerosol cans, or state-added universal waste under Part 273.

cadence: Fatality/catastrophe within 8 hours; covered hospitalization/amputation/eye loss within 24
evidence_description: Oregon OSHA confirmation, facts, timing, preservation record
fails_if: Waits for workers' comp; observation/inpatient confused; insurer-only notice; uncertainty delays call.
trigger_condition: A work-related reportable event occurs under Oregon definitions.
trigger_plain: A work-related reportable event occurs under Oregon definitions.

cadence: Each entry or authorized blanket certification
evidence_description: Customs certification and chemical-status support
fails_if: Blanket certification without review; article/mixture misclassified; restricted chemical certified without proof.
trigger_condition: Chemical, mixture, or covered article is imported and requires positive/negative certification.
trigger_plain: Chemical, mixture, or covered article is imported and requires positive/negative certification.

cadence: Preemployment; random/post-accident/reasonable suspicion/RTD/follow-up; Clearinghouse prehire and annual
evidence_description: Policy, tests, consortium, supervisor training, queries, RTD
fails_if: Starts before negative; query late; post-accident decision undocumented; supervisor untrained.
trigger_condition: Employs CDL drivers operating CDL-required CMVs on public roads.
trigger_plain: Employs CDL drivers operating CDL-required CMVs on public roads.

cadence: Annual Jan. 1-Mar. 1; update within 30 days after new reportable substance/change
evidence_description: CHS Manager annual/update filing and fee
fails_if: Only federal Tier II chemicals reported; low thresholds, waste, in-process, temporary/outdoor locations omitted.
requirement_name: Oregon Community Right to Know inventory
trigger_condition: Hazardous substance reaches Oregon quantity; common thresholds 5 gal liquid, 10 lb solid, 20 ft³ gas, with special rules.
trigger_plain: Hazardous substance reaches Oregon quantity; common thresholds 5 gal liquid, 10 lb solid, 20 ft³ gas, with special rules.

cadence: Maintain; communicate initially and after change
evidence_description: Plan, ignition control, housekeeping, maintenance, responsible-person records
fails_if: Hazards/inventory incomplete; static/hot work/contractors omitted; owners unnamed; storage mismatch.
trigger_condition: A standard requires it; written if >10 employees.
trigger_plain: A standard requires it; written if >10 employees.

cadence: Before covered activity; update after reportable site/status changes
evidence_description: Form 8700-12 or state site-ID confirmation and active EPA ID
fails_if: Wrong site/entity; stale address, contacts, generator category, waste codes, or activities; several sites share one ID.
trigger_condition: Site conducts hazardous-waste activity requiring an EPA ID; SQGs/LQGs clearly require one.
trigger_plain: Site conducts hazardous-waste activity requiring an EPA ID; SQGs/LQGs clearly require one.

cadence: Annually by March 2
evidence_description: ITA confirmation and upload file
fails_if: Company count replaces establishment peak; NAICS/EIN wrong; identifiers disclosed; late filing ignored.
trigger_condition: 20-249 in listed industries submit 300A; 100+ in Appendix B submit 300/301; 250+ recordkeeping establishments submit 300A.
trigger_plain: 20-249 in listed industries submit 300A; 100+ in Appendix B submit 300/301; 250+ recordkeeping establishments submit 300A.

cadence: Use-specific prohibition/phaseout/WCPP/notice clocks
evidence_description: Use analysis, sales controls, notices, WCPP and phaseout records
fails_if: Enforcement statement treated as rule; limited-use postponement overread; disposal/process-aid use missed.
trigger_condition: Manufactures, imports, processes, distributes, uses, or disposes of TCE.
trigger_plain: Manufactures, imports, processes, distributes, uses, or disposes of TCE.

cadence: Daily before use; chain sling periodic at least annually/more often severe
evidence_description: Pre-use process, unique IDs, periodic record
fails_if: ID missing; chemical/heat damage ignored; annual record not unique; damaged sling accessible.
trigger_condition: Slings used.
trigger_plain: Slings used.

cadence: Per known limitation/request
evidence_description: Notice, request/dialogue, hardship analysis
fails_if: Federal threshold used; forced leave; inconsistent light duty; notice absent.
trigger_condition: Employer has 6+ employees and accommodation is needed for pregnancy/childbirth/related condition.
trigger_plain: Employer has 6+ employees and accommodation is needed for pregnancy/childbirth/related condition.

cadence: Annual inspection; sprinkler main drain annually; maintain operable
evidence_description: Annual test/inspection, impairment/repair and valve/alarm records
fails_if: Blocked heads/closed valves/storage changes missed; vendor report incomplete; impairment unmanaged.
trigger_condition: Uses sprinkler or fixed extinguishing system.
trigger_plain: Uses sprinkler or fixed extinguishing system.

cadence: Before construction/operation; renew/report per permit
evidence_description: Current ACDP or Title V permit and reports
fails_if: New tank/blender/scrubber/boiler, throughput, formula, or fugitive source not screened; permit expired.
trigger_condition: Source/activity is listed, exceeds threshold, is new/modified major source, or DEQ requires a permit.
trigger_plain: Source/activity is listed, exceeds threshold, is new/modified major source, or DEQ requires a permit.

cadence: Continuous; generally 180 days or 270 days if transported >200 miles
evidence_description: Dates/labels, weekly inspections, aisle space, emergency arrangements, shipment records
fails_if: Late start date; open/leaking/incompatible units; >6,000 kg; generic inspections.
trigger_condition: Generates 100-1,000 kg/month nonacute waste and remains within SQG limits.
trigger_plain: Generates 100-1,000 kg/month nonacute waste and remains within SQG limits.

cadence: Specification interval, commonly 5/10/12 years; inspect before fill
evidence_description: Requalification mark/report, visual inspection, special-permit conditions
fails_if: Unreadable spec; wrong interval/method; permit unchecked; damaged cylinder filled.
trigger_condition: Fills/offers/uses DOT specification or special-permit cylinder.

fails_if: Only environmental report filed; undeclared/package failure/cost/injury omitted; no update.
trigger_condition: Transportation/loading/unloading release/incident meets criteria.
trigger_plain: Transportation/loading/unloading release/incident meets criteria.

cadence: Generally employment +30 years; access on required timeline
evidence_description: Monitoring, historic SDS/identity, medical records, access procedure
fails_if: Clinic-only inaccessible; worker/exposure group unlinkable; SDS overwritten; HR schedule destroys records.
requirement_name: Employee medical/exposure record retention and access
trigger_condition: Employer creates/maintains covered medical or exposure records.
trigger_plain: Employer creates/maintains covered medical or exposure records.

cadence: Continuous; waiver clocks per agreement
evidence_description: Selection/RIF records and OWBPA-compliant release
fails_if: Age-coded criteria; missing 21/45-day consideration or 7-day revocation; bad decisional-unit disclosure.
trigger_condition: 20+ employees for each working day in 20 weeks in current/preceding year.
trigger_plain: 20+ employees for each working day in 20 weeks in current/preceding year.

cadence: Per event; retain records
evidence_description: Notices, certification, ledger, reinstatement
fails_if: Old reason list; automatic overlap with Paid Leave; bereavement cap/policy stale.
trigger_condition: Employer has 25+ Oregon employees; post-July 2024 reasons include pregnancy disability, specified sick-child leave, bereavement.
trigger_plain: Employer has 25+ Oregon employees; post-July 2024 reasons include pregnancy disability, specified sick-child leave, bereavement.

cadence: SPD generally within 90 days; SMM statutory; Form 5500 by last day of 7th month, subject to extension/exemption
evidence_description: Plan, SPD/SMM, notices, 5500 receipt, fidelity bond where required
fails_if: Insurance booklet treated as SPD; practice differs; small-plan exemption wrong; no disclosure proof.
trigger_condition: Sponsors ERISA-covered retirement or welfare plan.
trigger_plain: Sponsors ERISA-covered retirement or welfare plan.

cadence: At least weekly
evidence_description: Dated checklist, findings, owner, corrective closure
fails_if: Prefilled/backdated; leaks, dates, labels, aisle space, incompatibles not checked; findings open.
trigger_condition: SQG/LQG accumulates hazardous waste in containers centrally.
trigger_plain: SQG/LQG accumulates hazardous waste in containers centrally.

cadence: Monitor smoke; annual pre-exposure training; controls escalate by PM2.5
evidence_description: Exposure determination, communication, training, controls, respirator records
fails_if: One AQI check; new EPA label not mapped; N95 unavailable; mandatory threshold treated voluntary.
trigger_condition: Exposure may reach PM2.5 35.5 µg/m³, subject to exceptions.
trigger_plain: Exposure may reach PM2.5 35.5 µg/m³, subject to exceptions.

cadence: Before movement and while required quantities/residues remain
evidence_description: Load/placard checklist and papers
fails_if: Mixed-load aggregation wrong; residue ignored; ID mismatch; damaged/obscured; uncleaned empty treated empty.
trigger_condition: Table 1/2 quantities meet placard rules.
trigger_plain: Table 1/2 quantities meet placard rules.

cadence: Before operation; state fee/permit; recurring detection/testing
evidence_description: DEQ registration, financial responsibility, detection and test records
fails_if: Ownership not updated; false exclusion; detection gaps; failed tests not repaired/retested.
trigger_condition: Owns/operates a regulated UST containing petroleum or another regulated substance.
trigger_plain: Owns/operates a regulated UST containing petroleum or another regulated substance.

cadence: Initial; repeat 3 months above PEL/6 months at action level; medical every 3 years for respirator ≥30 days/year
citation: 29 CFR § 1910.1053 as adopted by Oregon OSHA
evidence_description: Assessment, written control plan, housekeeping, training, medical
fails_if: Percentage-only review; nonroutine dust missed; dry sweeping; respirator day count wrong
trigger_condition: Powders/fillers/maintenance/cutting/cleanup may reach 25 µg/m³ action level
trigger_plain: Powders/fillers/maintenance/cutting/cleanup may reach 25 µg/m³ action level

cadence: Coverage each shift; flushing facilities immediately available; inspect on employer/code schedule
evidence_description: Coverage analysis, certifications, supplies, transport plan, eyewash/shower checks
fails_if: Night coverage gap; expired training/supplies; flushing blocked/distant/low-flow; bottle used as sole unit.
trigger_condition: No near clinic/hospital, first-aid response needed, or corrosive exposure possible.
trigger_plain: No near clinic/hospital, first-aid response needed, or corrosive exposure possible.

cadence: Continuous; update arrangements/postings/contacts
evidence_description: Responder arrangements, postings, coordinator and procedures
fails_if: No capability follow-up; unavailable coordinator; stale numbers; responders not assessed.
trigger_condition: Site is SQG.
trigger_plain: Site is SQG.

cadence: Initial/periodic; annual training; medical annual/semiannual by criteria
citation: 29 CFR § 1910.1018 as adopted by Oregon OSHA
evidence_description: Monitoring, areas, plan, training, medical
fails_if: Impurity/catalyst/recycling/maintenance missed; medical schedule wrong
trigger_condition: May reach 5 µg/m³ action level or covered operation
trigger_plain: May reach 5 µg/m³ action level or covered operation

cadence: Coverage before subject work; claim clocks per event
evidence_description: Policy, insurer posting, Form 801/claim, wage/return records
fails_if: Owner exemption assumed; temp allocation unclear; supervisor delays; OSHA/insurer reports confused.
trigger_condition: Employs workers not exempt.
trigger_plain: Employs workers not exempt.

cadence: Reports at least semiannual; certification at least annual
evidence_description: Monitoring/deviation reports and responsible-official certification
fails_if: Deviations omitted; units/terms missing; no-deviation unsupported; signer unauthorized.
requirement_name: Title V monitoring and compliance certification
trigger_condition: Facility has Title V permit.
trigger_plain: Facility has Title V permit.

cadence: Certification cycle (typically 2 years)
evidence_description: Current first aid/CPR certificates for designated responders
fails_if: All certs expired = no covered responder on shift
requirement_name: First aid / CPR designated responder certification
trigger_condition: No clinic/hospital in near proximity to the site
trigger_plain: No clinic/hospital in near proximity to the site

cadence: Supervised system at least annually; nonsupervised every 2 months
evidence_description: Test records, coverage and repair/impairment records
fails_if: Panel-only test; noisy/remote/accessible notification missed; frequency wrong; failed device remains.
trigger_condition: Alarm system meets an OSHA emergency requirement.
trigger_plain: Alarm system meets an OSHA emergency requirement.

cadence: March 1 of each even year for prior odd year
evidence_description: Form 8700-13A/B or state equivalent
fails_if: Only LQG months included; manifest mismatch; codes/wastes omitted.
trigger_condition: Site was LQG in any month; Oregon replaces with annual report.
trigger_plain: Site was LQG in any month; Oregon replaces with annual report.

cadence: Before each workshift; remove defective equipment
evidence_description: Pre-use process, unique ID, removal/destruction and rescue records
fails_if: Hardware/webbing/labels not checked; chemical/UV/impact damage ignored; no workable rescue.
trigger_condition: Uses personal fall-protection systems.
trigger_plain: Uses personal fall-protection systems.

cadence: Initially and annually
evidence_description: Annual education and designated-user training records
fails_if: Employees expected to fight fire without training; policy/practice conflict; designated users untrained.
trigger_condition: Employees may use extinguishers instead of evacuation-only policy.
trigger_plain: Employees may use extinguishers instead of evacuation-only policy.

cadence: Monthly visual; annual maintenance; hydrotest per Table L-1
evidence_description: Monthly tag/log, annual service, hydrotest
fails_if: Initialed without access/seal/gauge/damage check; overdue service; wrong hydro interval; bad unit remains.
trigger_condition: Portable extinguishers are provided.
trigger_plain: Portable extinguishers are provided.

cadence: Initial/periodic; annual training; medical at least every 2 years and after triggers
citation: 29 CFR § 1910.1024 as adopted by Oregon OSHA
evidence_description: Assessment, areas, plan, training, medical/CBD evaluation
fails_if: Alloy/trace/skin ignored; stale objective data; sensitized worker protections absent
trigger_condition: Beryllium action-level, dermal, symptom, or sensitization risk
trigger_plain: Beryllium action-level, dermal, symptom, or sensitization risk

cadence: Accrue 1 hour/30 or frontload; use by day 91; annual administration
evidence_description: Policy, accrual/use/pay/notice and attendance records
fails_if: Headcount/Portland threshold wrong; reasons narrowed; attendance points; balances wrong.
trigger_condition: All employees protected; paid at 10+ Oregon employees or 6+ with Portland location.
trigger_plain: All employees protected; paid at 10+ Oregon employees or 6+ with Portland location.

cadence: Renew every 5 years; maintain facts continuously
evidence_description: Certification, inspection, maps/photos
fails_if: Open dumpsters/loading/tank vents/residue/pallets/waste/equipment invalidate; not renewed.
trigger_condition: Covered industrial site seeks exclusion because all activity/material is sheltered.
trigger_plain: Covered industrial site seeks exclusion because all activity/material is sheltered.

cadence: Before significant new use; generally ≥90 days before
evidence_description: SNUR analysis, SNUN/EPA outcome, downstream notice
fails_if: Inventory checked but SNUR missed; changed PPE/customer use/release/disposal triggers rule; identity hidden.
requirement_name: Significant New Use Rule screening and SNUN
trigger_condition: Chemical is subject to SNUR and intended manufacture/import/process/use/PPE/release/disposal is a significant new use.
trigger_plain: Chemical is subject to SNUR and intended manufacture/import/process/use/PPE/release/disposal is a significant new use.

cadence: Register/exempt; payroll deductions each pay; enrollment/opt-out/re-enrollment
evidence_description: Registration/exemption, enrollment/opt-out, remittance
fails_if: Assumes payroll vendor registered; exemption stale; new hires missed; deductions remitted late.
trigger_condition: Employer has Oregon employees and no qualified retirement-plan exemption.
trigger_plain: Employer has Oregon employees and no qualified retirement-plan exemption.

cadence: Before/after each use and at least monthly
evidence_description: Monthly/post-use certification and corrective record
fails_if: Tag signed without pressure/regulator/alarm/elastomer/cartridge/storage check; expired escape unit deployed.
trigger_condition: Maintains emergency-use or escape respirators.
trigger_plain: Maintains emergency-use or escape respirators.

cadence: Continuous; train initially and when new chemical hazard introduced
evidence_description: Written program, inventory, current SDSs, labels, training
fails_if: Inventory/SDS mismatch; revision uncontrolled; secondary/process labels absent; generic training; contractors omitted.
trigger_condition: Employees are exposed/potentially exposed to hazardous chemicals in normal use or foreseeable emergency.
trigger_plain: Employees are exposed/potentially exposed to hazardous chemicals in normal use or foreseeable emergency.

cadence: Monthly visual + periodic formal inspection per tank category
evidence_description: Inspection records per tank, formal inspection certificates
fails_if: No records; formal inspection overdue; SPCC plan cites inspections never done
requirement_name: Aboveground storage tank formal inspections (STI SP001)
trigger_condition: ASTs subject to SPCC
trigger_plain: ASTs subject to SPCC

cadence: Every nonexcepted shipment before offering
evidence_description: Complete paper with description, quantity, packages, emergency phone, certification
fails_if: Sequence/notation missing; emergency phone unmonitored; quantity/package mismatch.
trigger_condition: Shipment not excepted.
trigger_plain: Shipment not excepted.

cadence: Continuous interactive process
evidence_description: Essential functions, dialogue, direct-threat and confidential medical record
fails_if: Stale job description; 100%-healed rule; blanket safety exclusion; medical data in personnel file.
trigger_condition: At least 15 employees for each working day in 20 weeks in current/preceding year.
trigger_plain: At least 15 employees for each working day in 20 weeks in current/preceding year.

cadence: LQG contact at 35 days/report at 45; SQG report after 60 days
evidence_description: Contact log, manifest, exception report, final confirmation
fails_if: Clock begins from wrong date; e-Manifest not monitored; report never closed.
trigger_condition: Signed receiving confirmation not received on time.
trigger_plain: Signed receiving confirmation not received on time.

cadence: Pre-trip each trip; post-trip where required; repair before unsafe operation
evidence_description: Pre-trip process, DVIR, repair certification
fails_if: Checklist after departure; trailer/placards/emergency gear omitted; defects repeatedly deferred.
trigger_condition: Operates covered CMVs.
trigger_plain: Operates covered CMVs.

cadence: Before independent use; evaluation every 3 years; refresher after trigger
evidence_description: Training, practical workplace evaluation, truck type, trainer/date
fails_if: Classroom-only card; different truck/workplace; temps grandfathered; 3-year date missed.
trigger_condition: Employee operates powered industrial truck.
trigger_plain: Employee operates powered industrial truck.

cadence: Immediate NRC notice
evidence_description: NRC number, call record, calculation, investigation
fails_if: Waits for final data; releases not aggregated; air/off-site migration overlooked; only local calls.
trigger_condition: CERCLA hazardous substance released to environment at/above RQ in 24 hours without exemption.
trigger_plain: CERCLA hazardous substance released to environment at/above RQ in 24 hours without exemption.

cadence: Before activity; renew per DEA schedule
evidence_description: DEA certificate and transaction/customer records
fails_if: Wrong activity/address; thresholds not aggregated; weak customer/suspicious-order controls.
trigger_condition: Manufactures, distributes, imports, or exports a List I chemical without exemption.
trigger_plain: Manufactures, distributes, imports, or exports a List I chemical without exemption.
